speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home. The bells are still going at four. They were going when I came up from the church, and they were going along Cheapside, and they have not given it up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He looked up, and he did not ask. The great house by the chapel can stay in the list.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The seal is where I left it. The eleventh is Thursday. I am not opening it to improve a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Phillips is not told. Not today. The page can wait till the house is quiet.
